name: Placetopay (Evertec)

webhook.algorithm: NOT AN HMAC HEADER. Placetopay uses WS-Security UsernameToken Profile 1.1 in an `auth` object inside the JSON body, containing login, tranKey, nonce and seed. tranKey = base64(SHA256(nonce_raw + seed + secretKey)); seed is the current time in ISO-8601, so a timestamp IS covered. There is no static signature header to verify inbound notifications — the same auth object model applies, and the recommended pattern is to query session status rather than trust a payload. Treat as `hmac_field_concat` with per-request derivation.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: login + secretKey pair; the secretKey NEVER goes on the wire — only the derived tranKey does. This is a genuinely different credential_model and cannot be expressed as secret_key_pattern.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. Per-country and per-merchant contract. Do not populate.

notes: Evertec-owned and the most widely deployed gateway across Central America and the Andean region — the practical answer for GT, HN, CR, PA and DO where regions.json has nothing. Its WSSE auth model is unlike anything currently in providers.json.
SDKs: Community SDKs exist (notably PHP via dnetix/redirection); official first-party coverage is thin. Docs are good and OpenAPI-adjacent.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps kushki across the Andean markets and dlocal_go in Central America. Its advantage is direct local acquiring in CR/GT/HN/PA/DO rather than aggregation.
Onboarding: application_review. Commercial agreement per country.
